Where can the black king go after Rf8+?
The g-pawn has moved and left g7 free.
items.explain: With the pawn on g5, Qxc8+ Bxc8 Rf8+ is only check: the king steps to g7. White has given up the queen and the engine rates the position as clearly worse. A combination has to be played to its last position before it is trusted.
